tools.name: search_hotels
tools.description: Find hotels by name, town, domain or register id (Algarve, Lisbon coast, Costa de la Luz). Use the property_id with get_hotel_facts. Facts are cited. precision is null.

tools.name: get_hotel_facts
tools.description: Latest cited facts for one hotel (own website or official register). Prefer property_id. A chain domain returns the property list instead of mixing hotels. Each fact has as_of, source_url, evidence.

tools.name: get_fact_changes
tools.description: Observed value differences across captures for one hotel. Not confirmed policy changes. Same identifiers as get_hotel_facts.
